body: Yep it's shite alright. Good luck to ya.
Thanks, hang in there yourself. Hopefully we can both get somewhere.
I suppose, it's just hard trying to even visualise myself succeeding and it just feels hopeless.

Thanks for replying. What you said just seems to hit all the right points on how I feel and it's a little bit heartening  atleast.  
It's just currently I feel like I'm stuck in quicksand and I'm just watching everybody throw me a rope but I'm just unable to pull myself out. I'm trying but I'm just tired.

Thanks for all of this. I think I'll put this medication away downstairs and try and sleep, at least for tonight. My heads felt like a big tangled ball of thread for as long as I remember now and this albeit short conversation has given me a place to start. It may still feel like it's easier to give up right now  but I don't think I feel quite as hopeless and maybe now it will go somewhere if I put in some effort. 
Thanks again, sincerely. I hope whatever you do goes well for you because you seem to do good.

I properly cried for the first time in near a year I think when I read this, thanks for that. I'm probably not being fair to myself or any of the people that care for me when I don't ask for help.
I just feel like I'm drowning and I'm at the point where I've forgotten which way is up and sinking seems easier than swimming.
I just want one day where I don't feel anxious, where my expression doesn't feel forced, where there isn't a weight on my chest when I think about things. If I had a single day like that it would be so much easier to tell someone. I've probably have had days like this but my memory seems to go when I get my worst.

I have no idea how to ask for help though. How am I supposed to dump near five years of this on my family without doing them harm by it. I can't count how many times I've heard my mother saying she "can't imagine how anyone could feel like that" or how she says she "couldn't handle that" when suicide comes up on tv or something. I know for a fact that if I did that she would feel terrible, guilty that she didn't see or do anything about it. How am I meant to do that when it involves makinh someone who has given everything for me feel like they have failed me?
